notes: One-job DATA step estimating the mean of Beta(0.1,10) by summing rand('beta',0.1,10)/N. The accumulation loop and rand() call are kept verbatim; loop count reduced 1e9 -> 1e6 so a single hosted run finishes quickly, and the estimate is placed in a one-row dataset and printed so it appears in the listing. Estimate is stochastic (unseeded rand), so only structural log/status fields are pinned, not the numeric mean.
